image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large crocodile resting on a rocky surface. The mouth is slightly open, revealing teeth and the interior of the jaw. The skin texture is highly detailed with visible scales and osteoderms. The lighting suggests an outdoor or well-lit enclosure environment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The checkpoint specifies 'when mouth is closed'. The subject's mouth is clearly open in the image, making this specific state untestable, although teeth are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is visible on the top of the head. While the pupil shape is hard to resolve at this resolution, the positioning is correct for a crocodilian.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are clearly visible at the anterior end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows significant length and heavy armor plating.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal scales are large, raised, and appear to follow a structured pattern consistent with osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of olive-green and grey/brown with a very rough, realistic texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) side is not visible in this profile shot; only the lateral and dorsal sides are shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are completely occluded by the angle of the shot and the rock the animal is resting on.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame to the right; its full length and compression cannot be verified.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring in the scale definition where the lower jaw meets the neck, lacking the crispness of the upper snout scales. Likely minor generation smoothing.
The teeth inside the open mouth lack distinct individual roots and gum lines; they appear somewhat fused into the jawbone rather than sitting in sockets, a common AI artifact in open-mouth animals.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'African crocodile' class. All testable checkpoints regarding head shape, snout structure, eye position, and dorsal armor texture are passed. The failures are due to occlusion or pose (mouth open vs closed, hidden limbs/tail), not incorrect features. The visible anatomy is taxonomically accurate.
artifact_reasoning: The image is high quality with realistic lighting and texture. Minor artifacts include slight fusion of teeth within the open mouth (lack of distinct gum separation) and minor texture softening at the jaw-neck boundary. No catastrophic structural errors or background bleeding observed.

metadata.class_label: African crocodile, Nile crocodile, Crocodylus niloticus
